question: Which of the following is a book written by Jyotirao Phule in 1873?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gulamgiri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Gulamgiri** is a seminal work written by **Jyotirao Phule** in **1873**.
 
• The book was written to expose the oppression faced by the lower castes in India.
 
• **Gulamgiri** translates to "Slavery" and compares the plight of the lower castes in India to the enslavement of African Americans in the United States.
 
• It was one of the first critiques of the caste system and sought to educate people about the injustices and inequalities perpetuated by it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jyotirao Phule**: An Indian social reformer, thinker, and writer who worked towards the eradication of untouchability and the caste system.
 
• **Satya Shodhak Samaj**: Founded by Phule in 1873, the organization aimed to liberate the lower castes from social and economic exploitation.
 
• **Education for All**: Phule and his wife, Savitribai Phule, were pioneers in promoting education for women and the lower castes in India.
 
• **Critique of Brahmanism**: Phule's writings, including "Gulamgiri," critically examined and challenged the dominance of Brahmanism in Indian society.
